definition.title: Directory submission pack
definition.description: Turns product metadata into a directory-specific submission pack — one section per target directory, formatted to each site's exact character limits — ready to copy-paste or hand to a VA.

human_review.summary: Review your directory submission pack before submitting to any directory. Check trimmed fields and warnings.

product_name.title: Product name
product_name.description: The exact canonical name of your product. Keep it consistent everywhere.

tagline.title: Tagline
tagline.description: Your one-line value proposition. Will be trimmed per directory character limit where needed.

website_url.title: Website URL
website_url.description: Canonical HTTPS homepage. Must start with https://. No trailing path or query string.

short_description.title: Short description (optional)
short_description.description: 2-3 sentences expanding on the tagline. Used for directories with longer description fields. Falls back to tagline if empty.

pricing_summary.title: Pricing summary (optional)
pricing_summary.description: e.g. 'Free plan available, paid from $19/mo'. Leave empty to omit.

category_tags.title: Category tags
category_tags.description: Up to 10 tags (e.g. AI, SaaS, Productivity). Each trimmed per directory limit.

founder_email.title: Founder contact email (optional)
founder_email.description: Required by some directories (G2, Capterra). Leave empty to omit from packs that don't need it.

target_directories.title: Target directories (optional)
target_directories.description: Names of specific directories to generate (e.g. 'Product Hunt', 'G2'). Leave empty to generate all 10.
